senses.gloss: f.(b. h. <cite ref="R00440"><he>צִיצִת</he></cite>; <cite ref="R00224"><he>צוּץ</he></cite> , v. <cite ref="R00229"><he>צוּצִיתָא</he></cite>)
hair-lock. Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII (ref. to Lev. XVIII, 3) שלא תגדל צ׳ that thou must not grow a lock (v. בְּלוּרִית).
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 26a">Zeb. 26ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 446:1">Yalk. Lev. 446</cite> <he>הוא בפנים וצִיצִיתוֹ וכ׳</he> if the sacrifice stands (within the sacred precincts), and its locks (prob. the tuft of its tail) are without.
Sifré Num. 115 אין צ׳ אלא דבר היוצא ודבר כל שהוא by tsitsith is meant something that protrudes (hangs over) and is of a minute size; Men. 41ᵇ. Sifré l. c. וצ׳ מן הגדילים, v. גְּדִילָה II.
<cite ref="Menachot 39b:8">Men. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>פטורין מן הצ׳</he> require no show-fringes; <he>חייבין בצ׳</he> require show-fringes; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:4">M. Kat. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 19a">19ᵃ</cite>), a. e., v. <cite ref="R00435"><he>צִיצָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>צִיצִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Menachot 44a:6">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>באו ארבע צִיצִיּוֹתָיו וכ׳</he> the four fringes of his garment came into sight and slapped him in the face (reproached him for his sensuality, reminding him of <cite ref="Numbers 15:39">Num. XV, 39</cite>). Sifré l. c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 3:7">Men. III, 7</cite> <he>ארבע צ׳ מעכבות וכ׳</he> the four fringes are dependent on one another, v. <cite ref="P00712"><he>עָכַב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 43a:3-9">Ib. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>אין … עד שיתיר צִיצִיּוֹתֶיהָ</he> you must not sell a fringed cloak to a gentile without removing its show-fringes; a. e.
